Immunoscore-IC within liver-met subgroup: Pint PFS=0.166, OS=0.473 (non-significant). All interaction tests are EXPLORATORY from a secondary analysis. Source: PMID 39908699 (ESMO Open 2025-02-04) — confirmed from PubMed abstract.
primary_result: pMMR: OS HR 0.80 (80%CI 0.63–1.02), p=0.117. Immunoscore-IC-high subgroup: higher benefit from atezolizumab. TMB-high: higher benefit (Pint=0.043).
failure_mode_primary: S — unselected pMMR enrollment diluted Immunoscore-IC-high signal
key_biomarker_finding: CANON NUANCE (CORRECTED): Liver mets are prognostic (worse PFS p=0.002, OS p=0.011) but NOT predictive of atezolizumab resistance in pMMR mCRC (Pint PFS=0.990, OS=0.800). Immunoscore-IC retains directional predictive impact in liver-met subgroup but interaction is non-significant (Pint PFS=0.166, OS=0.473). FOUR CAVEATS: (1) secondary analysis of Phase 2 trial; (2) pMMR not MSS-restricted — not directly comparable to BOT/BAL or RIN; (3) all interaction tests exploratory; (4) non-significant Pint does not prove equivalence. BOT/BAL and RIN no-liver-met signals in MSS-restricted populations remain the strongest validated patient selection evidence and are NOT superseded by this finding.
canon_status: PEER-REVIEWED — nuances prior canon on liver met framing. See contradiction ledger.
